book.name: HEBREOS
book.title: HEBREOS Hebreos're queti owa cojorica pũuro

content: Moisés cʉ̃ ca doti cũurique pea, bojocare añurije Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ cʉ̃ ca tiicojope ca doopere ca nii cõoña jʉorije niiupa. Cʉ̃ ca bojoca cʉti nii majuropeerije méé niiupa. To biri doti cũuirique pea, to cãnacã cʉ̃mara waibʉcʉrã díí mena joe jʉti añu mʉenerique mena Ʉmʉreco Pacʉre ca tii nʉcʉ̃ bʉo niirãre, jĩcãti ʉno peera ñañarije manirã cʉ̃ja ca tuaro cʉ̃jare tiiti.

Doti cũuriquera ñañarije manirã cʉ̃ja ca tuaro ca tiirije to ca niijata, “Mee ñañarije manirãpʉ mani nii yua,” ĩi tʉgoeñari, waibʉcʉrãre Ʉmʉreco Pacʉpʉre cʉ̃ja ca joe jʉti añu mʉene niirucurijere to cõrora tii yerijãacãbojacupa.
Biiropʉa, ate waibʉcʉrã jĩari cʉ̃ja ca joe mʉene cojorucuriquea, ñañaro cʉ̃ja ca tiirucurijere cʉ̃mari cõrora tʉgoeñari cʉ̃ja ca tii niirije niiupa.
Wecʉa díi, to biri chivoa díi, ñañarije tiirique wapare coe majiti.
To birira Cristo ati yepapʉre doogʉ, o biro ĩiupi Ʉmʉreco Pacʉre:

content.text: “Waibʉcʉrã joe mʉeneriquere, ñucã ‘Cʉ̃ yee niirucu’ ĩirã
cʉ̃ja ca jee dica woorijere, mʉ bootiwʉ.
To birira bojocʉ yʉre mʉ tiiwʉ.
Bojoca ñañaro cʉ̃ja ca tiirijere ñañarije manirã tuarʉgarã, waibʉcʉrã jĩari cʉ̃ja ca joe mʉene cojorucurijere mʉ ĩa biijejati.
To biri o biro yʉ ĩiwʉ: Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ ‘Anora yʉ nii,’ mʉ yaa pũuropʉre yʉ yee maquẽre cʉ̃ja ca owa cũu jʉguericarore birora, mʉ ca dotirore biro tiirʉgʉ.”

content: O biro ĩi jʉoupi: Waibʉcʉrãre jĩari joe mʉeneriquere, waibʉcʉrãre cʉ̃re cʉ̃ja ca tiicojo nʉcʉ̃ bʉorijere booti, ĩa nʉcʉ̃ bʉoti, biimi Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ, dotirique to biro ca tii dotirije ca nii pacaro.
Jiro ĩi nemoupi ñucã: “Anora yʉ nii, mʉ ca dotirore biro tiirʉgʉ,” ĩiupi. O biro ĩiri, waibʉcʉrãre jĩari joe mʉene nʉcʉ̃ bʉo niirucuriquere cõaupi, wãma wãme pee wajoarʉgʉ.
Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ cʉ̃ ca dotirore biro cʉ̃ ca tiirique jʉorira, ca ñañarije manirã mani ca niiro manire tiiupi, cʉ̃ majuropeera jĩcãtira cʉ̃ ca bii yai boja peoticã cojorique jʉori.

Niipetirã judíos, paia ca nii earã cõrora, tii wãme wadorena to cãnacã rʉmʉra waibʉcʉrã jĩari joe mʉene cojocõa niirucuma, cʉ̃ja ca ñañarije wapare jĩcãti ʉno peera ñañarije manirã cʉ̃ja ca tuaro ca tiitirije to ca niimijata cãare.
Jesucristo pea bojoca ñañaro cʉ̃ja ca tiirique wapare ametʉene bojagʉ, jĩcãtira bii yai boja yapano peoticã cojori, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ díámacʉ̃ nʉña pee ea nuu eaupi.
Toopʉ yue niimi, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ cʉ̃ waparãre cʉ̃ja ca doca cũmuro cʉ̃ ca tiiropʉ.
Jĩcãti bii yaigʉra, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ cʉ̃ ca jʉorãre añurã cʉ̃ja ca nii nʉnʉa waapere cʉ̃jare tii boja peoticã cojoupi.
Añuri Yeri cãa o biro manire ĩi wede majio nemomi:

content.text: “Tii rʉmʉri jiro cʉ̃ja menare ‘O biro yʉ tiirucu,’ cʉ̃ ca ĩirije pea, ‘Ate niirucu,’ ĩimi Wiogʉ: ‘Yʉ ca dotirijere cʉ̃ja yeripʉ ca niiro yʉ tiirucu. Ñucã cʉ̃ja ca tʉgoeñarijepʉ, owa tuuricarore biro cʉ̃ja ca majiro yʉ tiirucu.’ ”
“Ñañarije cʉ̃ja ca tii bui cʉtirijere, to biri ñañaro cʉ̃ja ca tii niirijere, pʉati teere yʉ tʉgoeña nemotirucu,” ĩimi.

content: To biri ñañaro mani ca tiirique wapare cʉ̃ ca acobo bojacãrique ca niiro macã, ñee ʉno peere ĩirã cõro, ñañarije tii wapa tuarique wapare waibʉcʉrã jĩari tiicojo ametʉene nemo majiña mani yua.
Ñañarije ca tiicõa niirãre wede majiorique
Yʉ yaarã, mecʉ̃ra uwiricaro maniro, Ca Ñañarije Mani Majuropeecãri Jawipʉre mani jãa waa maji, Jesucristo manire cʉ̃ ca bii yai bojarique jʉori,
Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ cʉ̃ ca bojoca cʉti niiri jawipʉre ea waa majiña maniro ca camota niirica quejerore, Jesucristo cʉ̃ majuropeera cʉ̃ ca bii yairije mena cʉ̃ ca pãa jãa waaricaropʉre.
Jesús'ra niimi mani yʉʉ pai ca nii majuropeegʉ, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ yaarã jʉguerore ca niigʉ.

To biri añuro yeri cʉticãri, díámacʉ̃ tʉo nʉcʉ̃ bʉorique mena, “To birora mani biirucu,” ĩi tʉgoeña ñee dopocãri, mani yeripʉre ñañarije tʉgoeñaricaro maniro mani upʉre oco añurije mena ñañaro mani ca tiiriquere ca coe ecoricarã niiri, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ pʉtore mani waaco.
Mani ca yue niirijere, “Yeera mani biicã” ĩiricaro maniro, to birora ca tʉgoeña bayicõa niiparã mani nii. Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ pea, “To biro yʉ tiirucu,” manire cʉ̃ ca ĩiricarore birora manire tiirucumi.
To biri mani ca niiro cõrora ameri tii nemo, bʉaro jañuro ameri mai, añurije wadore tii, tii niirica wãme peere mani amaco.

Jĩcãrã, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉre mani ca ĩi nʉcʉ̃ bʉo juu bue niiri taberire ca waatirãre biro ca biitiparã mani nii; biitirãra, mani ca niiro cõro, ameri wede majio tʉgoeña bayi, ca tii niiparã mani nii, mecʉ̃ docare Wiogʉ yaa rʉmʉ ca cõñacã doorijere ca ĩa majirã niiri.
Añurije queti díámacʉ̃ ca ĩirijere majicãri jiropʉra, tiirʉgarique mena ñañarijere mani ca tiicã nʉnʉa waajata, to biro mani ca tiirije wapare ca bii yai ametʉene bojapʉ manimi yua.
Ʉmʉreco Pacʉre ca junarãra, ñañaro cʉ̃ja ca biipe pecamepʉ ñañaro cʉ̃ja ca ʉ̃ʉ yaipe wado dʉja.
Noo ca boogʉ Moisés cʉ̃ ca doti cũuriquere ca ametʉene nʉcãgʉre, pʉarã, itiarã, cʉ̃ ca biirijere cʉ̃ja ca wedejãajata, ĩa mairicaro maniro cʉ̃re jĩa cõacãrucuupa.

Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ Macʉ̃re ca junarã, cʉ̃ ca bii yairiquera ca ñañarije manirã cʉ̃ja ca niiro ca tiiriquere ca junarã, ñucã Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ yʉʉ Añuri Yeri cʉ̃jare ca maigʉre ñañaro ca ĩirã doca, ¿ametʉenero ñañaro tamʉorucuma mʉja ĩi tʉgoeñatiti?
To biri Ʉpʉ o biro ca ĩiricʉre mani maji: “Yʉ yee nii ñañaro tii ameriquea, yʉ, yʉ ame bojarucu,” ĩiupi Ʉpʉ.
Ñucã o biro ĩiupi: “Wiogʉ, cʉ̃ yaa puna macãrãre ĩa bejerucumi,” ĩiupi.
¡Ñañarije peti niiro bii, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ ca caticõa niigʉre ñañaro tii ecorique doca!
Mʉja pea Jesucristo yee quetire mʉja ca tʉo nʉnʉjeericaro jiro, ñañaro tamʉo pacarã mʉja ca tʉgoeña bayiriquere acoboticãña.

Jĩcãrã mʉja mena macãrã, niipetirã cʉ̃ja ca ĩa cojoropʉ, ñañaro cʉ̃jare ĩi tuti eco, ñañaro tii eco, biiupa. Ñucã ape tabera mʉjare birora ñañaro ca tamʉorãre ĩarã, mʉja menara ñañaro ca tamʉorãre birora mʉja tʉgoeña nemoupa.

Tia cũurica wiipʉ ca niirã cãare cʉ̃jare mʉja ĩa maiupa. Mʉja ca cʉorijere cʉ̃ja ca ẽmajata cãare, ʉjea niirique mena mʉja niicãupa; ʉmʉreco tutipʉ mʉja ca cʉorije ca añu majuropeerije, to birora ca niicõa niirije peere majima ĩirã to biro mʉja biiupa.
To biri Jesucristore mʉja ca tʉo nʉnʉjee niirijere yerijãaticãña. Teera añurijere pairo mʉja ca tiicojo ecoro mʉjare tiirucu.
Mʉja, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ cʉ̃ ca boorore biro tiirʉgarã ñañaro tamʉo pacarã, to birora ca tʉgoeña tutuacãparã mʉja nii, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ “To biro yʉ tiirucu,” cʉ̃ ca ĩiriquere mʉja ca tiicojo ecopere biro ĩirã.
Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ wederique o biro ĩi:

content.text: “Yoari mééra doorucumi ca doopʉ. Yoaro bii mani waati majuropeecãrucumi.
‘Añugʉ niimi’ yʉ ca ĩigʉa, díámacʉ̃ cʉ̃ ca tʉo nʉcʉ̃ bʉo niirije jʉorira catirucumi.
Yʉ mena ca niimiricʉ amojode nʉcã cʉ̃ ca tuacoajata docare, cʉ̃ ca biirijere yʉ ʉjea niitirucu.”

content: Mania, ñañaro bii yairica tabepʉ
ñañaro bii yairʉgarã, añurije quetire ca tʉo nʉnʉjee yerijãarãre biro méé mani bii. Jesucristore díámacʉ̃ ca tʉo nʉcʉ̃ bʉorã niiri, ca ametʉarã pee niirã mani bii.
